changelog: Chat facelift: a real Material 3 dark theme with one accent instead of the Instagram/Snapchat gradient, vector icons in place of emoji glyphs, message grouping with day separators, per-message clocks and delivery state (sending/queued/failed with tap-to-retry), a scroll-to-latest button, an empty state and Snackbar status instead of a flickering label. Inbox rows now show a coloured avatar, a time and the last message. Fixed: the SSE loop spinning at 100% CPU when the stream closed immediately, a null bridge causing an infinite spin, duplicate messages when the stream beat the reply response, attachments reading a whole 25 MB file into memory to sniff 16 bytes, no HTTP write/call timeout so a stalled upload hung forever, the server's reply-rejection reason being swallowed, inbox ordering and timestamps parsed in the phone's timezone instead of the site's, a SharedPreferences write per keystroke, and a broadcast/notification lint set that would have crashed the poll service.
